# E0103: a version file has a package clause

A version file is not a CUE package: it is one version of one lineage, and the
compiler assembles the lineage from the files. A package clause does not belong
in it.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
package ship

Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
package ship

Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0103]: history/0.0.thema has a package clause
 --> history/0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | package ship
  | ^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: a version file is not a CUE package; remove the clause
```
